wages.text: Cervantes says on the Riverside City Council she voted to raise wages and helped create local union jobs.
wages.quote: she voted to raise wages, expanded trade training programs, and helped create hundreds of good-paying local union jobs.

housing.text: Cervantes says she worked to reduce regulatory barriers to building more affordable homes and to protect renters and homeowners from rising costs.
housing.quote: cut red tape to build more affordable homes, and protect homeowners and renters from rising housing costs.

sentencing.text: Supported crime-prevention approaches, greater investment in community programs, and rejecting legislation that lengthens sentences or increases penalties.
sentencing.quote: Will you publicly advocate for greater investment in community-based programs and services and reject legislation that lengthens sentences and increases penalties?

immigration.text: Opposed immigration raids and the expansion of detention and supported transparency and oversight of federal immigration enforcement.
immigration.quote: Do you publicly oppose ICE raids that have detained people without evidence or due process based on the color of their skin, language they speak, or occupation?

health.text: Cervantes says she will make health care more affordable and expand access, putting patients ahead of insurance and drug company profits.
health.quote: make healthcare more affordable, expand access to quality care, and make sure patients come before the profits of insurance and drug companies

tax.text: Castillo sponsored proposals to suspend California’s gas tax and end taxes on tips for service workers.
tax.quote: She emphasized her sponsorship of bills to suspend the state’s gas tax, end taxes on tips for service workers and audit state spending on homelessness and mental health programs.

immigration.text: Castillo joined a letter urging the federal government to expedite work permits for undocumented essential workers and said she supports humane and fair immigration practices.
immigration.quote: As a daughter of legal immigrants, I support humane and fair immigration practices, and public safety must remain a top priority.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: She introduced legislation stating that a parent declining to use a child's preferred pronouns or gender-affirming care is not child abuse.
gender.quote: a parent refusing to use their child's preferred pronouns, chosen name, or allowing their child to access gender-affirming health care is not an act of child abuse
